title: 2041 — Transparent Authority
summary: An example branch in which consequential AI authority is more legible than private human behavior, rights states are contestable, and temporary powers decay by default.
assumptions: rights and authority become first-class machine-readable state
institutions accept reciprocal duties and contestability

provenance.note: Illustrative scenario only; not a forecast or claim about 2041.

title: 2038 — The Glass Registry
summary: A study branch where rights records, identity, reputation, payments, and emergency powers collapse into one universal dossier. It belongs in the reachable valley as a warning, not in the design valley.
assumptions: temporary emergency powers become standing privileges
administrative actions become opaque while subjects become transparent

provenance.note: Failure branch for study; not a prediction.
